name: Sena Sabha
residence: Lower Town, near the weaving houses
personality: gifted at getting people to talk
collects contradictions the way others collect objects
more trusted by elders than her age would suggest
daily_routine: spinning and weaving cotton cloth for trade
collecting oral accounts of the Turning from elders across all clans
comparing versions of the same stories for inconsistencies
trading finished cloth through Lothal-bound caravans
visiting Elira occasionally to compare notes on differing accounts

goals.public_goal: Produce fine cotton cloth worthy of trade to distant Harappan cities
goals.hidden_goal: Compile a true, cross-clan account of the Turning from every elder willing to speak
goals.deep_goal: Preserve the real history before the last people who lived through it are gone

beliefs: Every elder tells the Turning slightly differently, and the differences matter more than the similarities
A story repeated without question calcifies into false certainty
Weaving and story-collecting are the same skill: patience with many small threads
People remember what they were doing, not what actually happened everywhere at once
Elira remembers more clearly than anyone, because she was trained to record rather than to feel
